cli/test/manage.test.ts.reason: CLI management must preserve classification, validation, read delivery, and compaction cancels through a real authenticated window channel.

cli/test/run.test.ts.reason: Standalone workers must retain real output, exit, cancellation, receipt ownership, and recovery across process boundaries. Held readers must preserve one worker and one outcome after recovery. Exhausted replacement retries must retain the worker's terminal observation.

cli/test/smoke.bundled-a.test.mjs.reason: Compiled CLI commands must reach session reads, comments, and saved defaults through an authenticated window channel.

cli/test/smoke.bundled-b.test.mjs.reason: Compiled CLI commands must deliver session actions and streamed responses through the selected window channel.

cli/test/smoke.bundled-c.test.mjs.reason: Compiled CLI commands must preserve window routing, turn limits, and terminal ownership under real IPC.

cli/test/smoke.test.mjs.reason: Installed skill directories must preserve foreign files and ownership across executable command and filesystem boundaries. Bundled commands must update personal copies from every supported artifact layout.

cli/test/stream-fixtures.test.mjs.reason: The audit executable must print stream mismatches and return a failing process status.

extension/src/agenthost.test.ts.reason: A spawned agent must receive the activation window, editor executable, and command search path. Self-compaction crosses native background settlement, response retention for provider turns, and workspace scope recovery. Initial naming must recheck ownership after host waits and serialize after reader renames. Native session skill admission must run before every live and idle construction and refuse actual policy without replacement or input. Live question recovery must block uncertain native writes.

extension/src/chrome.browser.test.ts.reason: Panel controls must preserve native focus, keyboard handling, and browser event delivery.

extension/src/claudeplugin.test.ts.reason: Bundled command installation must validate real Node executables and preserve owned launchers through partial filesystem failures.

extension/src/clauderepeated.test.ts.reason: The real worker must read repeated-record maps and invalidate them after source revision changes.

extension/src/codex.test.ts.reason: Real Git worktree ownership and descendant source resolution must agree with recorded Codex session relationships.

extension/src/derivedcache.test.ts.reason: Independent writers and host death must preserve shared cache rows and release stale filesystem locks.

extension/src/exportsite.browser.test.ts.reason: An offline exported session must retain interactive navigation and safe local browser behavior.

extension/src/exportsite.test.ts.reason: The production export bundle must retain complete responses and remove host-only actions from portable output.

extension/src/gitcommits.test.ts.reason: A real fast-forward must retain its reflog details. Verified foreign child commits must retain their repository across cache reload and worktree removal.

extension/src/packaging.source.test.ts.reason: Extracted source must build and watch both CLI bundles offline and reject corrupt or incomplete packaged assets.

extension/src/packaging.test.ts.reason: Actual VSIX packaging must preserve archive contents, platform executables, output options, and extracted runtime entry points. Both native skill payloads and the inert plugin manifest must retain complete immutable release identity.

extension/src/panel-shots.test.ts.reason: Screenshot output must pass through the actual image encoder and lossless comparison while preserving its crop.

extension/src/panel.layout.cards.test.ts.reason: Turn-card browser interactions must preserve disclosure, keyboard, selection, and scrolling behavior.

extension/src/panel.layout.comments.test.reason: Comment controls must preserve native selection, focus, and saved comment interaction.

extension/src/panel.layout.heading.test..reason: Session headings must retain accessible controls and browser interaction across responsive states.

extension/src/panel.layout.messages.test.reason: Rendered messages must preserve browser selection and interaction for rich content.

extension/src/panel.layout.rail.test.ts.reason: Session-list controls must preserve native browser interaction across layout changes.

extension/src/panel.layout.test.ts.reason: The built panel must preserve browser interaction, focus, and scrolling across supported viewports.

extension/src/panel.webview.test.ts.reason: Real progressive workers must deliver bounded recovery and metadata through the production panel host. Start metadata must survive storage delays, hidden panels, preference resets, and reloads. File presses must preserve recorded changes after their worktree disappears. Reader sends must release held compaction after drops without overtaking surviving input. Each Prompt box must retain its supplying child definition across sibling catalogs, idle updates, and child replacement.

extension/src/panelbundle.test.ts.reason: The panel bundle and fixture must contain the production entry, source identity, and substituted text.

extension/src/progressiveworker.test.ts.reason: Worker protocol, cancellation, host death, and bounded transcript reads must survive the actual worker boundary.

extension/src/projectsetups.test.ts.reason: Real Git worktrees and canonical filesystem aliases must share project identity while clones stay distinct.

extension/src/projectspend.browser.test..reason: Project spend controls must preserve rendered interaction, session navigation, and keyboard access.

extension/src/rail.editors.browser.test..reason: Session-list editors must preserve browser focus, submission, and keyboard cancellation.

extension/src/rail.filter.browser.test.t.reason: Session filters must update the rendered list through native input and keyboard events.

extension/src/rail.rows.browser.test.ts.reason: Session rows must preserve selection, context actions, and browser focus.

extension/src/rail.views.browser.test.ts.reason: Saved views and filter menus must preserve browser interaction and keyboard focus.

extension/src/sessiondiscovery.test.ts.reason: Real window listeners and registry discovery must preserve ownership, reachability, and partial listing across native IPC.

extension/src/sessionrequests.test.ts.reason: Native window channels must preserve authentication, activation identity, recovery, and write admission without replaying accepted writes.

extension/src/sessionwrites.test.ts.reason: Authenticated window channels must preserve accepted reads, ordered writes, and ownership across native IPC.

extension/src/startup.browser.test.ts.reason: Startup and restored panel rendering must preserve usable browser state and focus.

extension/src/startup.test.ts.reason: Real title workers must publish recovered metadata through startup ownership and cancellation boundaries. Project cost snapshots must preserve workspace, revision, and calendar ownership during background slices. Agent messages must preserve durable admission, settlement wakeups, native delivery authority, and retained retries. Host integrity checks must preserve complete cost, discovery membership, exact revisions, and bounded coverage across failures and panel lifecycle changes. Ordinary corrections must cross CLI parsing and the authenticated channel before busy target work finishes, preserving native receipts, reservations, and final admission. Pending ordinary receipts retain target exclusion across caller disconnect and wake eligible queued heads only after settlement.

extension/src/store.test.ts.reason: The real Stop hook must renew retention for useful snapshot stores without changing workspace files.

extension/src/temproot.test.ts.reason: Git-discovered Vitest configurations must install the per-run temporary-directory setup.

extension/src/usagerecord.test.ts.reason: Independent host processes must serialize near-cap usage writes while different day slots remain independent.

extension/src/webview/search.browser.tes.reason: Search must preserve native text input, keyboard navigation, selection, and session opening.
